verified_key_information_units.information: Performance decline was primarily driven by three external factors: loss of control over Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian confiscation of the Talvis distillery; and a global spirits market downturn, compounded by delayed excise tax payments that led to bank account freezes.

These developments created significant cash-flow pressure and delayed excise tax payments.

verified_key_information_units.information: The company initiated Legal Protection Proceedings (LPP) in January 2026 (court-approved in February) to restructure liabilities and stabilize operations; the deadline for the LPP action plan was later extended to October 2026, with legal effects remaining in force until August 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: The LPP filing automatically triggered an event of default under the Principal Shareholder's (Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l.) bond documentation, which in turn triggered events of default under its bank financing arrangements.

verified_key_information_units.information: Subsequent to the report period, in April 2026 the Principal Shareholder initiated judicial reorganization proceedings (réorganisation judiciaire) in Luxembourg, receiving a four-month moratorium until August 2026, during which enforcement actions against bondholders are suspended.
